title: いつか～
shortExplanation: Indicates an unspecified point in time; 'someday', 'one day', 'at some point'.
longExplanation: The grammar point いつか is used to indicate an unspecified point in time, meaning 'someday', 'one day', or 'at some point' in the future or the past. It can be used in sentences to express hopes, dreams, or possibilities.

examples.jp: いつか日本に行きたいです。
examples.en: I want to go to Japan someday.

examples.jp: 彼はいつか有名な作家になるでしょう。
examples.romaji: Kare wa itsuka yuumei na sakka ni naru deshou.
examples.en: He will become a famous writer someday.

examples.jp: いつかあの山を登りたいと思っています。
examples.romaji: Itsuka ano yama wo noboritai to omotte imasu.
examples.en: I think I want to climb that mountain someday.

examples.jp: 彼女はいつか夢を叶えることができると信じています。
examples.romaji: Kanojo wa itsuka yume wo kanaeru koto ga dekiru to shinjiteimasu.
examples.en: I believe she can achieve her dream someday.
